summary: Voice input needs the audio worklet file served at /audio-worklet-processor.js; without it every recording fails. Required for every app with voice input, RecordedSttAdapter included. New: glirastes stt worklet copies it, and glirastes doctor fails without it.
howTo: Chain the copy step in front of your scripts: "predev": "glirastes stt worklet && <existing predev>" and the same for prebuild. It copies glirastes/react/audio-worklet-processor.js (new package export) into public/ (--out <dir> for another static folder) and leaves an identical copy alone. Re-running glirastes init adds it for Next.js, Vite and Create React App. Served at another path: set voice.workletUrl (it now also reaches an own RecordedSttAdapter or DeepgramSttAdapter passed as voice.adapter) or the adapter's workletUrl. A Vite app with its own root or publicDir passes --out <that folder>. The copy can be Git-ignored. yarn berry and pnpm may skip pre* scripts: when next dev or vite is started directly, run glirastes stt worklet once first. Check with glirastes doctor (check voice-worklet).
